note: An engine-generated 1830 game (lr1's generator, 2026-10-26, saved game 53d758667c084902b6af1c0ca996d31c): two corporations of one president pass one train back and forth at $1, each buying it back on its next turn and leaving the other trainless, 174 times. The rule against train shuffling (BaseGame.no_buyback) forbids each of those buybacks; the game replays as played (process_action accepts them). buyback_indices: the action indices of those buybacks.
